description: Managed and engineered Oracle Database environments, including installation, configuration, maintenance, and support, with experience in Oracle ASM, monitoring, basic performance tuning, and day-to-day operational management.

Deployed and administered infrastructure in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including tenancies, virtual machines, networking components such as VCNs, subnets, route tables, security lists and NSGs, load balancers, and related cloud services.

Implemented and supported Kubernetes environments through Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) for microservices-based platforms, contributing to the availability, stability, and operational performance of the environment.

Served as technical lead for the Oracle Banking Digital Experience (OBDX) project between Banco del Austro and Oracle, coordinating technical efforts, defining architecture, supporting deployments, and troubleshooting issues end-to-end.
Administered middleware platforms including Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle HTTP Server (OHS), handling configuration, application deployments, hardening, and operational support.
Designed and developed a responsive website using Angular and Tailwind CSS.
Built and refined the visual interface, focusing on layout, usability, and mobile responsiveness.
Managed the project repository and deployment workflow through GitHub.
